title: Long-term Prognosis in Stroke Patients
brief_summary: A single-center cohort of patients with acute ischemic stroke and transient ischemic attack who admitted to the Severance hospital of Yonsei university and their long-term outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with acute ischemic stroke or transient ischemic attack

Exclusion Criteria:

* A patient who did not agree with enrollment of this study
study_population: All patients with acute ischemic stroke/transient ischemic attack
